journalName: RESEARCH ON LANGUAGE AND SOCIAL INTERACTION
raw_title: An interactional history of categorization and reference to an embodied action: How changing references are used to develop the referent itself in a series of theater rehearsals
title_en: An interactional history of categorization and reference to an embodied action: How changing references are used to develop the referent itself in a series of theater rehearsals

plain_summary_en: This paper studies An interactional history of categorization and reference to an embodied action: How changing references are used to develop the referent itself in a series of theater rehearsals. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Interactional, History, Categorization, And. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
